nodes.description: Public total token supply in BPToken, initialized to 2e9 * 10^18 in the constructor.
Owner address of Owned and ownedPool contracts; set from msg.sender and used by onlyOwner guards.
Dynamic address array of pool addresses; mutated by addPool/removePool and read by isPool.
Mapping of user address to BP token balance; read/written by transfer, transferFrom, balanceOf, constructor.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount; read/written by approve, transferFrom and allowance.
Mapping address=>AssetPool address recording which pool governs a user's locked tokens.
Mapping address=>base amount used to compute locked balances.
Seconds per month constant (2592000) used for linear release math.
AssetPool percentage of base amount locked.
AssetPool timestamp when the lock starts.
AssetPool timestamp when the lock ends.
AssetPool flag selecting linear release versus full release.
Address of the BPToken contract referenced by AssetPool.
BPToken constructor: mints totalSupply to msg.sender balances.
Constant function computing the minimum balance a user should hold, driven by block.timestamp and external AssetPool getters.
Internal getter returning addressPool[who].
Internal getter returning addressAmount[who].
Constant function returning balances[msg.sender].
onlyPool function that asserts and writes addressPool[who] and addressAmount[who] for a user.
Standard ERC20 balance getter returning balances[who].
ERC20 transfer; checks shouldHadBalance then moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
ERC20 transferFrom; spends allowed[from][msg.sender] and moves balances with safeAdd/safeSub.
ERC20 approve; checks shouldHadBalance and writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
Constant ERC20 allowance getter reading allowed[owner][spender].
onlyOwner function pushing a new pool address into the pools array.
onlyOwner function that scans and removes an address from the pools array and shrinks it.
Internal function iterating pools to test whether an address is a registered pool.
Owned.transferOwnership: onlyOwner, removes old owner from pools, adds new owner, sets owner.
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath division with zero and rounding assertions.
SafeMath subtraction with b <= a assertion.
SafeMath addition with overflow assertion.
AssetPool onlyOwner function calling bp.setPoolAndAmount then bp.transfer (external calls).
AssetPool onlyOwner function updating lock rule parameters.
AssetPool constructor validating times and setting owner and token address.
ownedPool.transferOwnership: onlyOwner updates owner address.
Constant AssetPool function returning bp.getBalance().
Caller-controlled address used in ownership, pool and authorization checks.
Miner-influenced timestamp used to compute locked/unlocked balances.
uint256 subtraction/addition on balances and amounts via safeSub/safeAdd.
External calls to AssetPool getters (getStartLockTime/getStopLockTime/getBaseLockPercent/getLinearRelease) inside shouldHadBalance.
External calls bp.setPoolAndAmount and bp.transfer to the BPToken contract from AssetPool.assign.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
Owned constructor pushes msg.sender into the pools array.
setPoolAndAmount is gated by the onlyPool modifier which checks isPool(msg.sender).
addressPool[who] is assigned msg.sender, granting pool control to the caller.
transfer reads balances[msg.sender] and shouldHadBalance(msg.sender).
transferFrom spends and decrements the allowance of msg.sender.
shouldHadBalance depends on block.timestamp for lock/unlock decisions.
Timestamp-based comparisons inside shouldHadBalance decide the held balance.
shouldHadBalance reads addressAmount[who] through getBaseAmount.
shouldHadBalance performs external calls to AssetPool view getters.
value parameter flows into transfer and its balance arithmetic.
to parameter flows into transfer and the balances[to] credit.
transfer uses safeSub/safeAdd arithmetic on balances.
balances storage is updated after the safe arithmetic.
from parameter flows into transferFrom.
transferFrom uses safeAdd/safeSub arithmetic on balances.
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], touching allowance state.
who parameter flows into setPoolAndAmount.
amount parameter flows into setPoolAndAmount.
setPoolAndAmount accumulates addressAmount[who] += amount.
newOwner parameter is used to update the owner in transferOwnership.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender == owner before transferring ownership.
transferOwnership calls addPool for the new owner.
transferOwnership calls removePool for the old owner.
removePool mutates and shrinks the pools array.
isPool iterates the pools array to find a match.
spender parameter flows into approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] = value.
approve checks shouldHadBalance(msg.sender) before setting allowance.
transfer checks shouldHadBalance(msg.sender) before moving tokens.
AssetPool.assign calls external bp.setPoolAndAmount then bp.transfer on the token contract.
shouldHadBalance uses perMonthSecond for release math.
block.timestamp feeds the unlock computation executed via external calls.
who parameter flows into shouldHadBalance.
AssetPool constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
setRule (onlyOwner) updates startLockTime.
setRule (onlyOwner) updates stopLockTime.
shouldHadBalance reads startLockTime via ap.getStartLockTime().
shouldHadBalance reads stopLockTime via ap.getStopLockTime().
to parameter flows into AssetPool.assign.
amount parameter flows into AssetPool.assign.
assign invokes bp.setPoolAndAmount on the BPToken contract before transferring.
ownedPool.transferOwnership (onlyOwner) overwrites owner.
safeSub implements the guarded subtraction tracked by the arithmetic unsafe op.
safeAdd implements the guarded addition tracked by the arithmetic unsafe op.
senderBalance local variable holds and writes the intermediate balance in transfer.
baseLockAmount local variable drives the returned locked amount in shouldHadBalance.
monthUnlockAmount local variable drives linear release math in shouldHadBalance.
hadPassMonth local variable is derived from block.timestamp in shouldHadBalance.
lockMonth local variable is derived from lock times in shouldHadBalance.
getPoolBalance calls bp.getBalance() on the token contract.
who parameter flows into getAssetPoolAddress.
who parameter flows into getBaseAmount.
